targets.rawSql: SELECT country, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN result_status THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS availability FROM monitoring_results WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '6 hours' AND ('$country' = 'All' OR country = '$country') AND ('$cert_type' = 'All' OR certification_type = '$cert_type') GROUP BY country ORDER BY country

SELECT created_at AS time, transaction_time_ms AS value, country || ' - ' || certification_type AS metric FROM monitoring_results WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND ('$country' = 'All' OR country = '$country') AND ('$cert_type' = 'All' OR certification_type = '$cert_type') ORDER BY created_at

SELECT created_at, country, certification_type, endpoint, transaction_time_ms, event_error_message FROM monitoring_results WHERE result_status = false AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour' AND ('$country' = 'All' OR country = '$country') AND ('$cert_type' = 'All' OR certification_type = '$cert_type') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Promedio Tiempo de Respuesta por Hora

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) AS time, AVG(transaction_time_ms) AS value, country || ' - ' || certification_type AS metric FROM monitoring_results WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND ('$country' = 'All' OR country = '$country') AND ('$cert_type' = 'All' OR certification_type = '$cert_type') GROUP BY time, country, certification_type ORDER BY time

panels.title: Promedio Tiempo de Respuesta por Día

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time, AVG(transaction_time_ms) AS value, country || ' - ' || certification_type AS metric FROM monitoring_results WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND ('$country' = 'All' OR country = '$country') AND ('$cert_type' = 'All' OR certification_type = '$cert_type') GROUP BY time, country, certification_type ORDER BY time

SELECT country || ' - ' || certification_type AS metric, SUM(CASE WHEN result_status THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exitosos, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT result_status THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fallidos FROM monitoring_results WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND ('$country' = 'All' OR country = '$country') AND ('$cert_type' = 'All' OR certification_type = '$cert_type') GROUP BY country, certification_type ORDER BY country
